d: The Manager- Operation Excellence is responsible for enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of cargo operations through the identification and implementation of process improvements, cost reduction strategies, and quality assurance protocols. This position is responsible for developing and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) to provide actionable insights and reports to senior management, ensuring operational performance aligns with organizational goals.
q: Bachelor degree Operations Management, Logistics, Aviation Management, Engineering, or related field.
A minimum of 6 to 8 years of experience in the same or similar field.
r: li
Ensure effective translation of the organizational strategy into operational business plans and monitor the performance of execution to achieve SACC’s objectives.
li
Formulate, in cooperation with the Director Regional Performance, the short- and long-term function strategy ensuring that it is properly executed and updated as required
li

Ensure proper implementation of the related policies and framework by managing the day-to-day operations of the function, providing guidance, encouraging teamwork, and facilitating the delivery of work processes to achieve high-performance standards.
li
Participate in annual budgeting cycle and process.
li
Manage the department efficiently and within budget, and report accurately on progress made and challenges encountered.
li
Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure operational performance, providing actionable insights and reports to senior management.
li
Establish and maintain quality assurance protocols to ensure compliance with safety, regulatory, and industry standards in cargo handling and transportation.
li
Work closely with various departments, including operations, logistics, finance, and customer service, to drive operational excellence initiatives.
li
Analyze operational data to identify trends, bottlenecks, and areas for improvement, utilizing data-driven decision-making to optimize processes.
li
Lead change management initiatives to facilitate the adoption of new processes and technologies within the cargo operations team.
li
Ensure that operational improvements align with customer needs and expectations, enhancing overall customer satisfaction.
li
Conduct periodic visits to regional stations to verify compliance with safety and security protocols. Implement and Ground handling activities profiles for the region.
li
Prepare required statements and reports timely and accurately to meet SACC’s and function requirements, policies, and quality standards.
